notes:
cer_canadas_energy_future: Canadian energy and macroeconomic projections conditional on the selected report edition and policy scenario.
  - macro-indicators: Canada-level real GDP, deflator and exchange-rate series; macroeconomic paths provide provincial transport-demand growth proxies and currency-conversion inputs.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with port-count mixes, rated-power trajectories and CAD2022 equipment/installation costs per port. Model cost is total port expenditure divided by total rated power. Aggregated infrastructure retains manual annual utilization 0.20/0.30 for LDV/MHDV; explicit archetypes derive utilization from matched operating inputs and a separately sourced home proxy. Source-specific endpoint holds remain explicit.
  - published_report: Tables 6 and 38 provide evolving port-count composition; Tables 12 and 21 provide matched equipment cost/power, with DCFC rating held at 300 kW after 2040. Aggregate LDV/MHDV rates pool expenditure and rated power from the same components as explicit archetypes. Explicit LDV public/workplace utilization uses Table 31. Table 19 MHDV inputs are private overnight 8 hours/vehicle and 1 vehicle/port/day; public overnight 6 hours/vehicle and 1.5 vehicles/port/day; private fast/MCS 0.5 hours/vehicle and 3 vehicles/port/day; public fast/MCS 0.5 hours/vehicle and 6 vehicles/port/day. Reference annualization multiplies occupied hours/day by 300 operating days and divides by 8,760; the transformation description records selected controls. Public 100 kW overnight cost scales the private 50 kW cost linearly; home L2 uses public-L2 capex as a proxy. National MHDV composition transfers to each province; projected mix after 2040 is held, not a new port forecast.
nlr_alternative_fueling_infrastructure: U.S. residential L1 installation cost midpoint of 550 USD per port from the 100–1000 USD range; equipment cost is zero. The 2021 dollar year is a reviewed manual basis, not explicitly stated in the source table. Normalize to rated power only after currency conversion and port-count aggregation.
